vulnerability.owasp: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures

exploitation.proof: Server accepted JSON containing __proto__ and returned HTTP 201 Created with created user object. The application processed an object with an __proto__ property instead of rejecting or sanitizing it — demonstrating a mass-assignment vector that can lead to prototype pollution in JavaScript runtimes.

remediation: Whitelist allowed fields and explicitly remove/ignore __proto__, constructor, prototype keys; avoid Object.assign from untrusted input; use safe merging libraries.
